images.title: Naming the eighths marks
images.purpose: Show that each mark on a unit cut into 8 equal gaps is named by the number of gaps from 0, and that the last mark, 8/8, is 1.
images.composition: One unit drawn very large across the frame from 0 to 1, with three counting arcs over the first gaps and a highlighted end mark.
images.exact_structure: A grey #6B7280 number line from 0 to 1 only, drawn long, with exactly 9 evenly spaced ticks making 8 equal gaps. Exactly 3 equal teal #0072B2 arcs above the first 3 gaps, from 0 to the 3rd tick. The 3rd tick carries a small amber #E69F00 dot. The last tick, at 1, carries a small reddish purple #CC79A7 dot. Ticks 4 to 7 stay unlabelled. Exactly 1 number line, 3 arcs, 2 dots.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
a label 4/8 or any other text on the 3rd tick besides 3/8
images.takeaway: A mark n gaps from 0 is n/8, and 8/8 is 1.
images.description: One unit from 0 to 1 cut into 8 equal gaps; the first three marks read 1/8, 2/8 and 3/8 with 3 teal arcs counting the gaps, and the last mark reads 8/8 = 1.
images.context: Shown with the concept as its one key picture, next to the walkthrough video. PLACEHOLDER: specified, not generated yet.
images.teaching_notes: Ask the student to name the unlabelled marks by counting gaps from 0 up to 8/8 = 1.

image_decisions.why: Naming marks by gaps counted from 0 is clearest on one large eighths line.
